verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a fiat-to-crypto payments and on-ramp platform (APIs, SDKs, widgets), not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The documented MCP server for its docs is a server-side capability: it serves content to other agents and does not let users plug MCP servers into MoonPay, so it does not make this axis applicable.
